default_home.description: Base path for user home directories (used when expanding paths like ~user).

default_quota.description: Default mailbox quota for new users (in bytes or '0' for unlimited).

syslog_logfile.description: Path to maildrop-specific log file (used only when LOGGING=1).

syslog_logging.description: Enable logging of delivery decisions and errors to the syslog/logfile.

verbose.description: Enable very detailed logging (includes header parsing and filter evaluation).

max_message_size.description: Maximum allowed message size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

max_recipients.description: Maximum number of recipients per message to prevent abuse.

filter_pre.description: Path to a pre-delivery filter script (e.g., virus scanner) to run *before* maildrop.

filter_post.description: Path to a post-delivery filter script (e.g., spam classifier) to run *after* successful delivery.

trusted_ips.description: List of IP addresses trusted for relay without authentication.

description.description: Human-readable description of this trusted IP.

relay_hosts.description: List of hosts to use as SMTP relays for remote delivery.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the relay server.

port.description: Port to connect to on the relay (e.g., 25, 587). Optional; defaults to 25.

use_tls.description: Use STARTTLS (or implicit TLS for port 465) when connecting.

auth_user.description: Username for SMTP AUTH on the relay. Optional.

auth_pass.description: Password for SMTP AUTH. Optional; leave empty if not using auth or if using external auth (e.g., OAuth2).

delivery_method.description: Default delivery format for local mailboxes.

maildir_path.description: Relative path to the Maildir base directory (under user's home).

maildirpp_enabled.description: Enable Maildir++ extensions (folder separators, folder naming conventions, and quota support).

mbox_path.description: Absolute path to the mbox file (supports {user} substitution). Only used if delivery_method=mbox.

custom_delivery_path.description: Custom delivery command/path (e.g., ' |/usr/bin/procmail' or a file path). Only used if delivery_method=custom.

delivery_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for external delivery attempts before timeout/bounce.

retry_max.description: Maximum number of retries for transient delivery failures before giving up.

retry_delay.description: Base delay (in seconds) between retries; delay grows exponentially (retry_delay * 2^attempt).

dns_lookup.description: Enable DNS MX record lookup for remote delivery instead of using RELAYHOST.

dns_fallback.description: Hostname to attempt if MX lookup fails (e.g., fallback domain or smart host).
